name: kata
description: Coaches programming reasoning: attempt first, progressive hints, unaided transfer. Not a model trainer.

interface.shortDescription: Coach de raciocínio em código com pistas graduais
interface.longDescription: A coaching skill that asks you to attempt the reasoning before it helps. It releases hints one rung at a time, asks for confidence before revealing correctness, and re-tests the concept on a changed surface once the hints are gone. Katas here are engineering reasoning, not puzzle drills. It is not a model trainer and not a psychometric instrument.
defaultPrompt: Use $kata para treinar raciocínio em programação sem revelar a solução.
Use $kata to practice programming reasoning without revealing the solution.
